XizmatTop

Interface redesign: one palette instead of seven accent colours, light and dark themes, and clear booking on the web and in a Telegram Mini App.

Scope
UI redesign
Languages
4
Year

xizmattop

The brief

A booking service for specialists in Tashkent: plumbers, electricians, appliance repair, doctors, tutors and cleaners. It runs on the web and as a Telegram Mini App. The interface was overloaded: seven accent colours, wallpapers, a weather widget — all of it got in the way of the main action, booking a specialist.

What we did

  • One paletteBlue for navigation, orange for the single main button on each screen.
  • Light, dark and auto themesThe theme follows Telegram and phone settings.
  • 4 interface languagesUzbek, Russian, English and Chinese.
  • Audit of the existing siteWe found bugs in the catalogue listing and counters and fixed them in the new interface.
  • Hand-off package for the client's developerA clickable prototype, colour tokens, themes and translation dictionaries.
